patterns: APPSC asks Census 2011 religion one-liners: highest growth 2001-11 = Islam (2025), match religion to % share (Sikh 1.7, Christian 2.3, Buddhist 0.7, Jain 0.4; 2023).
UPSC-type items use absolute series (Christians 10.7 m in 1961 to 27.8 m in 2011) and largest-number states (Maharashtra for Buddhists).
Recurring traps: Christian-majority states (Nagaland, Mizoram, Meghalaya, not Arunachal), lowest sex ratio = Sikhs, highest literacy = Jains.
Only one genuine PYQ is filed here; app MCQs add minority-scheme, Waqf and AP minority-welfare items beyond PYQ depth.
